method.complete_code: Whole bounded clause or contract expected/prohibited effects have specific production code and meaningful source-running tests located. This is not an acceptance run, exact-head CI receipt, merge or market approval.
method.partial_code: Some actual production code and relevant tests or safeguards are present, but a named part of the clause, persisted business effect, negative case, role/mandate or integrated proof is missing.
method.no_implementation: No implementable owner for the key specified behavior located; incidental neighboring code does not make it partial.
method.unknown: Insufficient code evidence to assign even a partial implementation verdict.
method.verification: All 352 IDs were checked for uniqueness and exact path existence. Most cited tests were inspected as evidence but not executed during this audit.
